images.description: Appetizer - Baba Ganoush but skip the hummus for me because restaraunts usually add in starches or bean blends that will increase the glucose hit. The Main Entrée: Skewered Proteins - Chicken Souvlaki (Chicken Kabobs). Smart swaps: Ask to swap out the rice and pita bread for a double of the vegetables. Salad - Greek or Mediterranean salad with the authentic dressing (olive oil with red wine vinegar or lemon juice.
